comments.text:
Policy wording D. 2.6 - Specific treatment exclusions- Treatment involving Rotational Field Quantum Magnetic Resonance (RFQMR), External Counter Pulsation (ECP), Enhanced External Counter Pulsation (EECP), Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, KTP Laser Surgeries, Cyber Knife Treatment, Femto Laser Surgeries, Bioabsorb-able Stents, Bioabsorbable Valves, Bioabsorbable Implants. Use of Radio Frequency (RF) probe for ablation.

Yes, it might be an attractive policy to purchase, but if you're purchasing 20-25 lacs policy and these old age common diseases' treatment is excluded, then it's not worth it.

These diseases are apparently common in indian population (approximate Avg cost of these treatment for specific diseases in metro city is taken from perplexity) 
1) Rotational Field Quantum Magnetic Resonance (RFQMR) – Coronary artery disease – ≈₹1–1.5 lakh per course.
2) ECP / EECP – Chronic stable angina / refractory CAD – ≈₹1–2.5 lakh for 30–35 sessions.
3)Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy – Non‑healing wounds, radiation injury, CO poisoning – ≈₹3,500–6,000 per session.
4) KTP laser surgery – BPH / ENT lesions – ≈₹50,000–1.5 lakh per procedure.
5) CyberKnife treatment – Brain/body tumours, AVMs – ≈₹4–9 lakh per course.
6) Femto LASIK – Refractive error correction – ≈₹90,000–1.4 lakh for both eyes.
7) Bioabsorbable stent – Coronary artery disease – ≈₹30,000–40,000 per stent (older bioabsorbable types much higher).
8) Bioabsorbable valve – Valve disease needing replacement – surgery package ≈₹1.5–5 lakh+.
9) Bioabsorbable orthopedic implant – Fractures / ligament reconstructions – implant in tens of thousands; surgery usually ≥₹1 lakh.
10) Radiofrequency ablation (RF) – Arrhythmias / varicose veins / pain lesions – ≈₹80,000–2.5 lakh+ per procedure.
